text: Scranton, Pennsylvania. Two forty-seven P.M. An ordinary Tuesday.
Aisle five. Hair gel. The good kind. In and out. Nobody gets hurt.
Dunder Mifflin. Limitless paper in a paperless world. Also, apparently, food.
A forklift. So big. So hard to handle. That is what
No. Not today. I'm working.
Zero days since the last forklift incident. Somebody is having a day.
A shopping cart with one bad wheel. Just like me. Still rolling.
A beet. Samuel will want this. Samuel always wants the beets.
Aisle five. My old friend.
Extra hold. Because my hair, like me, does not quit.
Michael Scarn! Goldenface sends his regards!
Tell him I said: return to sender.
Uh, he is going to be upset if we come back without you.
Then you should have brought a bigger face.
You picked the wrong aisle, pal.
I'm not superstitious. But I am a little stitious.
Is he posing? Why is he posing?
I am a temp! This is my first day!
Reinforcements! We brought the other guys!
Great. More customers.
Um. Sir? Is that everything?
That is everything.
Do you... want a bag?
No. But you're going to need a mop.
Cleanup. On aisle five.
Michael Scarn. The best secret agent in the business.
He saved the NFL All-Star Game. The NBA All-Star Game. Even the M-B-A All-Star Game.
But the man called Goldenface took the one thing Scarn loved most. Catherine Zeta-Scarn.
Heartbroken, Scarn hung up his gun... and became a mild-mannered paper salesman.
Five years later. Scarn Manor.
Sir. Sir. Wake up, sir.
I'm up! I was resting my eyes. Both of them. At the same time.
It is two in the afternoon, sir. You fell asleep during Die Hard 2 again.
The best one.
The President is on the laptop.
The president of what?
The United States, sir.
Tell him I need a minute. I need to find my good face.
A portrait of me. Painted by me. From a photo of me. Taken by me.
Best Spy, three years running. Voted by me. Unanimously.
A real fireplace would be dangerous. Also expensive. This one is on YouTube.
Catherine. You'd know what to do. You always knew what to do.
This couch has seen things. Mostly me, crying at Marley and Me.
One of Samuel's beets. He grows them in the bathtub. I shower at the Y.
The President is waiting, sir. He has been waiting for eleven minutes.
World's Best Secret Agent. It's official. It's on a mug.
Michael Scarn. This is President Jackson. We have a situation.
I'm retired, Mr. President. I sell paper now.
I know. I buy your paper. It is very good paper.
Is this about the missing staplers? Because I have a theory, and his name rhymes with Shmim.
It is not about the staplers. Stop asking about the staplers.
Stand by. I need to turn around in my chair. Dramatically.
...Are you finished?
Yes. That was worth it.
Goldenface is back. He has taken the concession stand workers hostage at the NHL All-Star Game.
And he has planted a bomb somewhere in the stadium.
Goldenface. The man who took my wife.
Yes. He is also very rude on the phone.
Not the hot dog guys!
The hot dog guys, Michael. And the nacho lady.
Why would anyone attack hockey?
He says if the All-Star trophies explode, everyone will be covered in gold. Like him.
The game is in three days. You are the only man who can stop him. Will you do it?
I'll need to think about it.
Heads, I do it. Tails, I stay retired.
Heads. The coin has spoken.
Tails. Best two out of three.
Best three out of five. Standard protocol.
It landed on its edge. That is a sign. That is a very clear sign.
It rolled under the couch. Samuel, what did it say?
Heads, sir. I checked. Twice.
Mr. President. I'm in.
Thank you, Michael. America thanks you. Hockey thanks you.
One question, Mr. President. What is the threat level?
Midnight.
Then it is time... for one last mission.
Sir, the All-Star Game accepts one amateur player every year. You would need to qualify.
Samuel, I have never played hockey. I have seen it. On TV. Once.
There is one man who could teach you in three days. He lives in the mountains.
Cherokee Jack.
Cherokee Jack, sir.
Cherokee Jack! I need to learn hockey! By Thursday!
Who disturbs the ice?
Michael Scarn. They say you are the greatest hockey mind who ever lived.
They say a lot of things. Most of them I said first.
Hockey is not learned, Michael. Hockey is remembered.
I don't remember it.
Then we will remember it together.
Is that a Zamboni in your cabin?
That is a Roomba. His name is Wayne. He is also learning.
Are you the real Cherokee Jack?
There are many Jacks. I am the one with the puck.
What is your fee?
Your ego. Also forty dollars. Cash.
Five trials. The mop. The stick. The target. The obstacle. The reflex. Begin.
First, respect the ice. Clean it. Every scratch is a story. Erase the stories.
The puck is a small, angry moon. Pass it back and forth. Do not let it escape.
Shoot the targets. Not me. People always shoot me.
Life is an obstacle course, Michael. So is this. This one has cones.
Now I will throw things at you. Do not flinch until I say. Then flinch correctly.
I have cleaned this ice. Like my conscience. Mostly.
The puck and I have an understanding now.
I am a sniper. A hockey sniper. A snocker.
I fear no cone.
I have the reflexes of a cat. A very well-trained cat.
Jack. I think I have become one of the hottest hockey players in the country.
You have become... adequate.
Elite.
Remember, Michael. When all seems lost, the puck knows the way.
What does that mean?
I have no idea. Goodbye.
Listen up! The NHL All-Star Game takes one talented amateur every year. One!
Three of you. One lap. Winner gets the pass. Loser gets a juice box.
Chad Kowalski. They call me The Wall. Because I once ran into a wall. On purpose.
Michael Scarn. They call me Michael Scarn. Because that is my name.
Skaters, take your marks!
Well, well, well. Michael Scarn. On skates. How... ordinary.
Goldenface. Nice face.
Thank you. It is gold.
You will never make the All-Star Game. My associates will see to that. Associates!
We brought sticks this time!
Then let us play... hockey.
He shoots. He scores. On you.
Ow! Is that legal in hockey?
This is not over, Scarn! Nothing is ever over! That is my whole thing!
Mwa-ha-ha-ha-ha... ha. Ha.
Scarn! You hit four men with pucks.
That is actually fine. It's hockey. But you finished dead last. Chad wins!
Chad! Chad! Chad! I'm going to the All-Star Game! I'm going to hit the sauna!
Sir. The traditional Scarn solution to this problem would be... regrettable.
No, Samuel. We do this the nice way. We steal his identity.
Identity theft is not a joke, sir. Millions of families suffer every year.
Which is why we will be very, very careful.
A Zamboni driver uniform and a mustache. Nobody questions the Zamboni guy.
An instant camera. Smile, Michael. You are going to the All-Star Game.
I need a photo of my face to put on the pass. My best angle is all of them.
Out with Chad. In with Scarn. Nobody will ever know.
La la la! I am The Wall! Sauna time is Chad time!
Hey! Locker room is for players only!
Hm? Who is there?
Oh. Zamboni guy. Carry on, Zamboni guy.
Hiding in a locker. Like high school. But on purpose.
Samuel. We are in.
Congratulations, sir. You are now legally Chad.
I have always been a little bit Chad.
Sir. The fax machine has intercepted a transmission from Goldenface.
Our fax machine can intercept transmissions?
I upgraded it, sir. It is also a toaster now.
One name: Jasmine Windsong. She sings at The Funky Cat.
Jasmine Windsong. That sounds like one of Jan's candles.
She is a singer, sir. At the hippest jazz club in town.
The hippest jazz club in town.
The only jazz club in town, sir. The password is "Beets".
Of course it is.
Password.
Bears.
Beets.
Battlestar Galactica.
No. Nice try. Come back when you know things.
Welcome to The Funky Cat. Two drink minimum. The drinks are Capri Sun.
Lost and found? We have one tape recorder. Some guy named Michael left it. He records his "ideas".
Michael is a genius. I will take it. For safekeeping.
A napkin. It says "desrever". French, maybe. Or German. Or... hm.
Tonight's set list. Song three: "Muidats Eht Rednu, reprise." Sounds Swedish.
She only sings in code on Tuesdays.
What day is it?
At The Funky Cat, man, it is always Tuesday.
A beet on a jazz club table. Samuel has been here.
A disco ball made of old CDs. Mostly Nickelback. Tragic.
The bar is a vending machine. It takes quarters and dreams.
A front row table. For a front row man.
I should get something to record the show with. The bartender looks like a lost-and-found kind of person.
Ladies and gentlemen... the one... the only... Jasmine Windsong.
This next one is called... The Stadium. I mean. Just a song.
The hostages are under the stadium. Of course. That is where they keep the stadium.
Michael. There is something you should know. Goldenface is not working alone. He is working with—
Nooooooooo!
A sleeping dart, sir. She will wake up in eight hours with a mild headache and no memory of tonight.
Lucky.
There he is! Get Scarn!
Samuel, the kitchen! Every great escape goes through a kitchen!
Too many cooks!
Is that chili? Why is there so much chili?
We are clear, sir.
Under the stadium, Samuel. Tonight, we go underground. Like a mole. A sexy mole.
The hostages are under the stadium.
